text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Vivlos was defeated in the Yushun 
Himba (Oaks), she shifts her focus to the 
remaining tiara to avenge her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to claim the Tiara and meet 
everyone's expectations, Vivlos asks to 
find one more thing she can be confident 
in during summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To build momentum toward the Tiara, Vivlos 
and her Trainer set their next target on 
the Shion Stakes.
